rig: MPFB game_engine (53 bones, leg bones unweighted) + serpent chain tail_01..tail_12 + weapon_r socket
godot_target: Godot 4.7 PhysicalBoneSimulator3D + PhysicalBone3D children of the Skeleton3D

conventions.space: body_offset / joint_offset are Transform3D in the bone-local frame of the imported Skeleton3D bone (Blender bone frame, +Y along the bone)
conventions.capsule_axis: local Y (CapsuleShape3D default); height = total incl. caps
conventions.hinge_axis: joint frame Z; engine hinge angle = -(right-hand rotation of the child about Z) as in Bullet/GodotPhysics/Jolt-in-Godot; Z is set so the angle equals the stated meaning
conventions.limits: degrees, relative to the bind pose (joints are created at rest)
conventions.serpent_boxes: tail segment boxes: bone Y along the body, bone Z = belly (roll set to the ventral direction in stage 2), segments abut at the joints

mass_assumption: heavy 1.84 m alien with a ~1.9 m serpent body: torso 40 kg (carapaces ride on spine_03), waist 12, head 12, arms tapering 5 / 3.5 / 2 kg, serpent chain 75 kg by segment volume; floor 0.8 kg per body
non_simulated: Root, spine_01, neck_01, clavicles, digits, leg bones (unweighted) and weapon_r follow their simulated parent with their animated local pose (at bind on the hand-off frame)

bones.meaning: positive = more elbow flexion; bind pose already flexed 43.2 deg
positive = more elbow flexion; bind pose already flexed 43.2 deg

footprint_rule.rule: User decision 2026-10-01: no containment box or tile walls; gentle push only. The serpent coil already lies on the tile; the collapsed torso tips over onto it. Drop tests report how far anything ends outside the 2 m x 2 m tile as tuning information.
footprint_rule.origin: tile centre on the walking surface (unit origin)
footprint_rule.game_logic: If the game moves the body (e.g. no floor -> lower level), that is game logic, not physics.

handoff.initial_velocity: continue the clip: per-bone linear/angular velocity from the last two frames of the variant
handoff.variant_rule: shot travel direction t in the unit frame (x = unit right, y = unit forward; glTF/Godot: x right, -z forward): t.y <= -0.707 -> Front (shot from the front), t.y >= 0.707 -> Back, else t.x > 0 -> Left (shot from the unit's left), else Right. Play Death<variant>, hand off on its last frame with that variant's velocities. "Death" is a copy of DeathFront.

extra_push.direction: SHOT TRAVEL DIRECTION: apply delta_v (as impulse = delta_v x body mass) to every body in "bones" along the horizontal travel direction of the killing shot (shooter -> unit, world space), whatever the facing; the vector here only carries the magnitude

variation.note: per death: rotate the push direction about the vertical by a uniform random angle in [-jitter, +jitter] and add a random vertical-axis spin of up to spin_jitter to spin_bone, so corpses differ; 0 disables

handoff.ground_clearance_rule: at the hand-off, if any collision shape is below the walking plane, lift all bodies by that depth + 2 mm before releasing them (a depenetration launch is worse)
handoff.no_turn: user decision 2026-10-02: no animated turn toward the attacker; the variant and the push handle the fall direction and the twist below turns the upper body toward the shooter as physics

twist_toward_shooter.bodies: all (every PhysicalBone3D incl. the whole serpent chain)
twist_toward_shooter.pivot: mass centre of all bodies at the hand-off (horizontal position)
twist_toward_shooter.scale: angle between the unit facing and the direction from the unit to the shooter / 180 deg: 0 for a frontal shot, 0.5 from the side, 1 from directly behind
twist_toward_shooter.sign: toward the shooter: counter-clockwise seen from above (+Y) when the shooter is on the unit's left; from directly behind (within 1 deg) pick the side at random per death
twist_toward_shooter.apply: at the hand-off, after the variant velocities and the push: w = up x (max x scale x sign); for EVERY body: angular_velocity += w; linear_velocity += w.cross(body_centre - pivot) with body_centre and pivot taken in the horizontal plane (a rigid rotation of the whole unit, so the joints are not strained and the push momentum is unchanged)
twist_toward_shooter.intent: he tries to turn round too late while still being pushed away from the attack (user 2026-10-02)

handoff.fall_direction: away from the shooter (along the shot travel direction)

assist.rule: once the fall is over (simulation time >= after_s and every body slower than below_mps), raise the damping of every body to at least these values (Godot DAMP_MODE_REPLACE) so residual contact jitter of the light limbs dies out (Sectoid v3 rule); the Blender drop tests run without it

settle_and_freeze.action: freeze: copy the simulated bone poses into the Skeleton3D pose and stop the simulation (static corpse)

fit.method: vertex-cloud fit in bone frames (open skin under the vest); boxes grown 10 mm, serpent boxes 5 mm

blender_drop_tests.engine: Blender 5.1 rigid body (Bullet), 30 fps x 20 substeps, 60 iterations, split impulse, cone joints approximated by GENERIC 6-DOF limits, margin 2 mm
